name: OpenRAC Editor runtime
author: OpenRAC
description: Plays what OpenRAC Editor packs with a level: its cutscenes (camera, characters, subtitles in the disc's language, voices, music; Start skips one) and the behaviours given to mobys (spin, bob, patrol, orbit, face or follow the hero). A level made in the editor needs it on.

settings.name: Play cutscenes
settings.description: Off skips every cutscene as it starts; what it leaves in the world still happens. In a party the host's choice counts.

settings.name: Subtitles
settings.description: Show the cutscenes' lines at the bottom of the screen.
